seo.title: Naming Conventions
seo.description: File and variable naming conventions: kebab-case files, interface prefixes, backend type suffixes, and hook naming rules

header.title: Naming & Linter Rules
header.description: Strict semantic conventions designed to eliminate ambiguity and technical debt through static analysis.

benefit_text: Naming consistency simplifies navigation, and automated linter checks prevent architectural debt accumulation.

files.label: Files and Case:
files.text: Universally using <one>kebab-case</one>, including hooks (<two>use-auth.ts</two>, the function itself is useAuth). Exceptions: utility files (<three>entity.type.ts</three> format) and standard Next.js files.

typing.label: Types and Code:
typing.text: Interfaces with <one>I</one> prefix, types with <two>T</two> prefix, enums with <three>ENUM_</three> prefix. Components use <four>PascalCase</four>.

eslint_filename.title: ESLint: filename-case
eslint_filename.description: Enforce with <one>eslint-plugin-unicorn</one> (<two>unicorn/filename-case</two>). Semantic suffixes stay allowed via ignore; hooks are plain kebab-case (use-x.ts).

eslint_types.title: ESLint: naming-convention
eslint_types.description: Gate <one>I*</one> / <two>T*</two> / hooks via <three>@typescript-eslint/naming-convention</three>. ENUM_* type aliases are excluded from the T* prefix rule.

fsd_rules.title: FSD Import Architecture
fsd_rules.description: Classic layer hierarchy: <one>shared</one> is the lowest, <two>app</two> is the highest. Upward imports or imports between elements of the same layer are strictly prohibited.

relaxations.title: Technical Relaxations
relaxations.description: ESLint overrides for vendor UI (<one>shadcn-ui</one>), type declarations (<two>.d.ts</two>), and config files where strict naming would fight the toolchain.
